acceptanceCriteria: The fail-open rate under load1 >= 100 is measured with retained evidence.
Either the deadline handling is changed with a focused -race test, or an evidenced known-limit disposition cites V1-0844 and the load envelope.
body: Seen in RC3 lane E (V1-0397 non-reproduction, PR beamfall/corvint#741, 2026-10-10): 200 HLQ claude-code runs with corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 build 0, N-1 rc.2 build 360, adapter 0.3.1, Claude Code 2.1.293, darwin/arm64 M2 Max, load1 52-259 (median 122) from 8 yes burners plus 2 loops. Evidence: docs/build-log/2026-10-10-v1-0397-upgrade-sessionstart-nonrepro.md and docs/build-log/evidence/v1-0397/runs.tsv on that branch. In 11 of 200 runs the frontier Stop decision failed open on dogfood-event-deadline, the shape completed under V1-0844. V1-0844 is COMPLETED, so this is either a residual under load above its tested range or a regression. Decide whether to tighten the bound or record the load envelope as a known limit.
title: Frontier Stop fails open on dogfood-event-deadline under high host load (V1-0844 shape)
